content.text: Create a high-quality editorial scientific design illustration in a wide 16:9 canvas, 2048x1152, contrasting two NPC operating structures for a research explainer. Use a clean ivory diagram field with nautical slate and deep navy framing, restrained copper and teal signals, precise vector-like geometry, subtle paper grain, and polished publication-grade visual hierarchy. On the left, show a short, linear guarded-proposal path as a compact sequence: one proposal card enters a single unchanged hard validation/commit gate, then a result exits; make this path visibly shallow and limited, without implying it is inferior by measurement. On the right, show a larger fixed-goal event-driven recovery loop: a stable goal anchor at the top; event and new observation entering an observation snapshot; a player utterance becoming an untrusted claim and typed intent; a reviewed planning context flowing to a symbolic planner/replanner; a proposal moving into the same hard validation/commit gate used on the left; an action result and new observation feeding back around the loop. Make the hard gate visually identical in both lanes and clearly unchanged, highlighted with a copper outline and a small shield-like symbol, while the evolving observation/intent/planning stages use teal signal arrows. Show the separation between fixed goal authority and adaptive plans through composition: the goal anchor remains stationary and the planner loop changes routes around it. Use only a few short, crisp diagram labels if needed (for example GOAL, OBSERVE, INTENT, PLAN, GATE, RESULT); do not rely on readable baked text, do not add paragraphs, metrics, numbers, fake charts, screenshots, software UI, or empirical claims. The image is an illustrative architecture concept, not a runtime screenshot and not evidence of implementation. Original composition, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism.
